name: Claude Code · Sonnet 5.5
prompt:
Make a promo video for a gig, in a kinetic typography style (huge heavy type slamming in on the beat, full-frame colour-block cuts).

Gig: Echo Project — city tour, Chicago night
Date and venue: November 22, The Foundry

Requirements:
- Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, 15–25 seconds
- Structure: open on the gig name → bring in the band, date and venue over 2–3 scenes → end with ticket info
- Include music and sound effects; export one mp4 with audio to the current directory
